content.json:
## Honeypot SOC Overview
  Live attacks against T-Pot honeypots, detected by 51 custom Wazuh rules and forwarded to Microsoft Sentinel (level 7+).

content.query:
WazuhAlerts_CL
| where Honeypot != "other"
| summarize Alerts = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Honeypot
content.title: Attacks over time, by honeypot

content.query:
WazuhAlerts_CL
| where isnotempty(SrcIp)
| summarize Alerts = count(), Honeypots = make_set(Honeypot), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SrcIp
| top 10 by Alerts
content.title: Top 10 attackers

content.query:
WazuhAlerts_CL
| summarize Alerts = count() by Severity = case(RuleLevel >= 12, "High (12+)", RuleLevel >= 10, "Medium (10-11)", "Low (7-9)")
content.title: Alerts by severity

content.query:
WazuhAlerts_CL
| mv-expand Technique = MitreIds to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Technique)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Technique
| top 10 by Alerts
content.title: Top MITRE ATT&CK techniques
